proofs.text: Open the board with the regulated fixture and set each filter in turn; verify `Untested` leaves login and export with login showing `RULE-4`, `Failing` leaves 0 spec rows, `Weak` leaves login, invoice and export with login showing `RULE-4`, `Unsigned` leaves login, checkout_design and export with login showing `RULE-4`, `Stale or held` leaves login alone showing `RULE-2` and `RULE-3`, and that the filter set reads as pressed each time

Open the board with the solo fixture and verify the filters offered read `Untested` and `Failing`; open the team fixture and verify `Weak` follows them; open the regulated fixture and verify `Unsigned` and `Stale or held` follow those, 5 in all

rule_text: The board offers the filters the gate reaches, `Untested` and `Failing` at every gate, `Weak` at `strong`, `Unsigned` and `Stale or held` at `signed`, and each narrows the table to the rules it accepts

def test_each_filter_narrows_the_board(browser, tmp_path, filter_id,
                                       features, login_rules):
    page = open_board(browser, tmp_path, payload_named('regulated'))
    page.click('[data-filter="' + filter_id + '"]')
    assert page.get_attribute('[data-filter="' + filter_id + '"]',
                              'aria-pressed') == 'true'
    assert feature_names(page) == features
    if login_rules:
        page.click('[data-act="feature"][data-feature="login"]')
        assert rule_ids(page) == login_rules
    page.close()
tests.name: test_each_filter_narrows_the_board[failing-features1-login_rules1]

def test_a_filter_above_the_gate_is_not_offered(browser, tmp_path):
    """A project at `passed` is never asked about strength or signatures."""
    solo = open_board(browser, tmp_path / 'solo', payload_named('solo'))
    assert texts(solo, '.chip') == ['Untested', 'Failing']
    solo.close()

    team = open_board(browser, tmp_path / 'team', payload_named('team'))
    assert texts(team, '.chip') == ['Untested', 'Failing', 'Weak']
    team.close()

    reg = open_board(browser, tmp_path / 'reg', payload_named('regulated'))
    assert texts(reg, '.chip') == ['Untested', 'Failing', 'Weak', 'Unsigned',
                                   'Stale or held']
    reg.close()
tests.name: test_a_filter_above_the_gate_is_not_offered
